title: Wire header_map_cid into build_article pipeline and update docs
description:
Why: the new type and field are inert until the ingest pipeline calls build_header_map() and stores the resulting HeaderMapNode block in IPFS. All ingest paths (POST, IHAVE, mbox import) must populate header_map_cid.

What:
1. In build_article() (crates/core/src/ipld/root_node.rs or wherever the IPFS write occurs): call build_header_map(raw_header_bytes), serialize to DAG-CBOR, write to IPFS, capture CID, store as header_map_cid.
2. Verify all three ingest paths use build_article() (or the equivalent) and will therefore automatically populate the field.
3. Update wire_format.md §4 (ArticleRootNode field table) to add header_map_cid row.
4. Update wire_format.md §11 worked example to show header_map_cid in the pipeline steps.
5. Update architecture.md 'IPFS block storage' diagram/table to show the new block.
design: build_header_map() must be called with the same raw_header_bytes used to compute header_cid, ensuring both blocks represent the same headers. The HeaderMapNode block is written to IPFS before the ArticleRootNode block (since the root node embeds the CID). No schema_version bump.
